0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Mavericks visit the Rockets. Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), while Houston's Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting was on January 31, 2026, in Houston, where Dallas lost 111-107.
